note: Running hybrid incident log. One entry per incident; append new ones each run, update attr when attribution changes and record the move in attrLog.

incidents.place: Belgium: Flanders, Wallonia, Brussels; Hoepertingen (BE Limburg)
incidents.summary: Store refrigeration controllers. About 40 Delhaize, 15 Carrefour, about 15 Intermarché and 5 Spar stores plus IKEA Mons. Stock discarded; one store lost at least €60k; freezers at 15 °C instead of −22 °C.

incidents.place: Netherlands: regions not named
incidents.summary: Danfoss systems at 17 firms (butchers, small shops, one cold store found at −10 °C against −20 °C). Large chains unaffected.

incidents.place: Sweden, Luxembourg, Ireland, Estonia, Finland
incidents.summary: Same method. Six Coop stores and an Axfood distribution centre near Gothenburg (SE); 13 of 223 SuperValu stores (IE); a Selver freezer set to +50 °C (EE).

incidents.place: Ukraine and Russia
incidents.summary: National air-raid alert apps pushed false nuclear and chemical alerts for about an hour. Ukraine's app suspended; Russia's emergencies app hit hours later.

incidents.place: Poland: Podlasie, Warmia-Masuria
incidents.summary: Sabotage threat. National police full readiness 2–8 Nov; counter-terrorism units deployed to the Kaliningrad border.

incidents.place: Sweden: off Gotland
incidents.summary: Police boarded a Russia-linked cargo ship and checked crew papers. No arrests.

incidents.place: Jersey (UK)
incidents.summary: Drone reports closed the airport on two nights; flights cancelled or diverted.

incidents.place: Italy: Catania and Palermo (Sicily); cases also in Tuscany and Emilia-Romagna
incidents.summary: Display-case controllers at three Coop-brand stores in Catania and one in Palermo were reset remotely around 04:00; trade sources say at least 12 Sicilian stores. Italy's National Cybersecurity Agency (ACN) also found a catering firm in Tuscany and a frozen-food producer in Emilia-Romagna hit.
src: Anche l'Italia colpita dagli attacchi hacker ai supermercati: Chigi convoca un vertice d'urgenza

incidents.place: Romania: six stores of one chain (cities not named)
incidents.summary: Fridges in six stores heated up overnight and staff found them at 08:00. The National Cyber Security Directorate (DNSC) says the controllers sat behind cellular (GSM) routers with fixed IP addresses, reachable from the internet, on old software.
src: Frigiderele din 6 magazine din România, posibil vizate în noul atac

incidents.place: Germany: Wuppertal and Raesfeld (North Rhine-Westphalia); Reisbach (Bavaria)
incidents.summary: Germany's first cold-chain cases: refrigeration heated to about +50 °C at an Edeka in Reisbach, a CAP-Markt in Wuppertal and a Rewe in Raesfeld (Danfoss controls set to defrost); stock discarded, police complaint in Wuppertal.
src: Mutmaßlicher Cyberangriff auf Rewe-Markt in NRW

incidents.place: Portugal: seven Intermarché stores
incidents.summary: Seven Intermarché stores hit, reportedly through an outside refrigeration contractor (AFP, single source).
src: New Wave of Refrigeration Cyberattacks Hits Supermarkets Across Europe

incidents.place: Latvia: Krāslava and Ludza
incidents.summary: Unidentified drone entered from the east at 18:59; orange alert; a Blaze interceptor drone launched and self-destructed short of the Russian border; the object left after about 17 minutes.
src: Latvian military deploys interceptor drone against unidentified drone

incidents.place: Germany: Nuremberg region (planned targets); Romania: Brașov (arson on 14 Sep)
incidents.summary: Two Belarusian men are held in Germany on European arrest warrants from a Bucharest court. Romanian prosecutors say they set fire to a defence company in a Brașov industrial park on 14 Sep; security sources told Der Spiegel they planned fires near a railway line and a power transmission route in the Nuremberg region. Romania's intelligence service (SRI) places them in a “Moscow-controlled espionage and sabotage network”.
src: 2 Belarusians arrested in Germany over alleged sabotage for Russia

incidents.place: Poland: Świdnica (Lower Silesia)
incidents.summary: Police detained a 55-year-old Russian citizen seen photographing trains and rail infrastructure near a level crossing; his devices held “hundreds of thousands” of images of transport sites in Poland and abroad. He is charged with spying for a foreign intelligence service and held for three months. Security services coordinator Tomasz Siemoniak said such activity “has always been accompanied by prior reconnaissance and information gathering.”
src: Russian citizen detained in Poland on suspicion of spying after photographing trains and rail infrastructure

incidents.place: Germany: Kaiserslautern and Kusel districts
incidents.summary: Polizeipräsidium Westpfalz confirmed on 3 Nov that a food-processing company and a supermarket in the Kaiserslautern and Kusel districts were hit in the refrigeration-controller wave. The area hosts the US Kaiserslautern Military Community. No claim of responsibility.
src: Hackerangriffe in Europa: Supermärkte müssen Lebensmittel entsorgen

incidents.place: Germany: Lilienthal near Bremen; Wetter-Volmarstein
incidents.summary: dpa lists a supermarket in Lilienthal near Bremen (cooling set to about 30 °C; the owner puts losses above €360,000) and an AWO-run market in Wetter-Volmarstein among German stores hit in the night to 2 Nov. The attack reportedly went through the company that maintains the systems remotely.
src: Hackerangriffe in Europa: Supermärkte müssen Lebensmittel entsorgen

incidents.place: Ireland: 13 SuperValu stores
incidents.summary: SecurityWeek reports 13 SuperValu stores in Ireland hit in the refrigeration-controller wave, part of more than 100 stores in Europe; Estonia, Luxembourg and Finland also report cases. Store locations not published (marker at the country centre).
src: Over 100 European stores hit as supermarket fridge attacks return

incidents.place: Latvia: eastern border area
incidents.summary: Latvia's military believes a drone that entered on 2 Nov was Ukrainian; it crashed inside Latvia and has not been found. NATO air-policing jets were activated. Crash site not published (marker at Ludza).
src: Latvia believes one of two drones that violated its airspace was Russian, the other Ukrainian

incidents.place: France: three EFS plasma cold stores (sites not named; marker at EFS headquarters, Saint-Denis)
incidents.summary: Temperature and defrost thresholds were raised to “extremely high levels” through refrigeration supplier Coolworld, which blames a third-party component; alarms caught it and the blood service says no products were compromised. France's cyber agency ANSSI and the health ministry are investigating.
src: Blood banks hit by cyberattack in France days after European freezer hacks
French blood banks foil new cyberattack targeting refrigerators

incidents.place: United Kingdom: small meat-processing firms (not named; marker at Birmingham)
incidents.summary: Richard Horne, chief executive of the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC), said hackers tried to target small meat processors with minimal impact and that “vulnerable technology had been exploited” in a couple of cases.
src: EU urges action as Germany, Romania and UK report supermarket cyberattacks

incidents.place: Europe: at least 27 flights (BE, FR, RO, BG, ES, CZ, AT, IT, DK); marker at Brussels Airport, about 105 km from Heerlen
incidents.summary: Hoax bomb threats hit at least 27 flights; LOT's Warsaw–Brussels flight landed normally after a threat, a note reading “bom” was found on a Ryanair aircraft at Charleroi, and an Aer Lingus flight was diverted to Évreux. No device found.
src: New bomb threats force more European flights into emergency landings
Nieuwe bommeldingen op luchthaven Boekarest, ook verdachte melding op vlucht vanuit Charleroi

incidents.place: Gulf of Finland: two Finland–Estonia telecom cables (marker mid-gulf)
incidents.summary: Helsinki District Court convicted the Fitburg's Russian captain (3 years 6 months) and Azerbaijani boatswain (2 years 10 months) of aggravated criminal damage on 5 Nov 2026; the anchor was lowered deliberately and dragged about 130 km. Appeal intended.
src: Finnish court jails Russian captain over Baltic Sea cable sabotage
Vrachtschip sleepte anker 130 km over zeebodem: 2 bemanningsleden veroordeeld voor zware sabotage

incidents.place: Poland: towns not named (marker at Warsaw)
incidents.summary: ABW arrested five Poles and a Russian accused of smuggling military components worth more than PLN 2 million into Kaliningrad, June 2023 – December 2025; four charged with espionage.
src: Poland arrests six suspected of spying for Russia and supplying its military

incidents.place: Europe: at least 17 flights (CZ, FR, IT, PT, HU, BG, DK, NL); marker at Prague
incidents.summary: Hoax bomb threats hit at least 17 flights by midday GMT, nine of them to or from Prague; four aircraft over France landed at Orly and Bordeaux, and a KLM flight from Prague was checked at Schiphol. No explosives were found.
src: Hoax or bomb threats? What we know about flight disruptions across Europe
European air traffic targeted by several new threats after a week of hoaxes
Bommeldingen over vluchten in Europa, pand Ierse omroep ontruimd om dreiging

incidents.place: Dublin: RTÉ, Newstalk, Irish Independent; also Sky News (UK), Nova TV (BG); marker at Donnybrook
incidents.summary: An email headed “MESSAGE TO THE WEST” threatened newsrooms in Ireland and the UK; RTÉ's Donnybrook campus, Newstalk and the Irish Independent were evacuated.
src: Government 'will go after' those behind media outlet threats
A week of cyberattacks and bomb threats: what do we know?

incidents.place: Lithuania: sites not named (marker at Vilnius)
incidents.summary: Lithuania's State Security Department expelled three Ukrainians it says took paid tasks from hostile foreign services via Telegram, including filming sites; no criminal case was opened.
src: Three Ukrainians expelled from Lithuania before doing any actual damage: VSD

incidents.place: Rome (online leak; marker at Rome)
incidents.summary: Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani said hackers published personal data on him and his family on the darknet and offered to pay for more; Prime Minister Meloni's office expressed solidarity over “the activities of pro-Russian hackers”. [65]

incidents.place: Manche: Orano La Hague and EDF Flamanville (marker at La Hague)
incidents.summary: Several drones flew over the La Hague reprocessing site and the Flamanville nuclear plant, putting services at the Cherbourg naval base on alert; the prefecture and both operators confirmed the flights. [66]
src: Des sites ultra sensibles dans la Manche survolés par plusieurs drones : le mystère demeure

incidents.place: Black Sea, about 24 km south-east of Sulina in Romanian waters
incidents.summary: Varna prosecutors said on 7 Nov that human remains were found on the drone-struck tanker Wine Trader in a Bulgarian repair yard; seven of its 12 crew had been missing, and AFP counts at least nine merchant ships hit by drones off Romania and Bulgaria since early October, with 34 dead or missing. [67]
src: Human bodies found on ship struck by a drone in Black Sea

incidents.place: Online (marker at Berlin)
incidents.summary: Posts claimed Chancellor Merz called the Hamburg Nord Stream trial senseless because “Das deutsche Volk hat der Ukraine verziehen”, the German people have forgiven Ukraine; no record exists and the government called it “Desinformation”. [68]
src: Augsburg checkt's: Merz-Kommentar zu Nord-Stream-Prozess ist frei erfunden

incidents.place: Cologne area, rail network (exact site not given; marker at Cologne)
incidents.summary: WDR reported on the evening of 8 Nov that after vandalism and signal-box damage in the Cologne area rail traffic was slowly resuming: “Der Staatsschutz ermittelt”, the state-security police are investigating. About 75 km from Heerlen. [57]
src: Vandalismus sorgte für Bahnstörungen im Raum Köln (feed teaser)

incidents.place: Drochia and Soroca districts, northern Moldova (marker at Drochia)
incidents.summary: Moldova's defence ministry said two aerostat-type objects crossed its airspace illegally, one entering near Moșeni and leaving near Elizavetovca, the other coming from the direction of Vinnytsia toward Trifăuți; it counts 69 violations in 2026. [42, 43]
src: Two aerostat-type objects illegally entered national airspace
Moldova records 69 airspace violations since early 2026

incidents.place: Kraków (online campaign; marker at the Rynek Główny)
incidents.summary: Digital Affairs Minister Krzysztof Gawkowski said on 9 Nov that false claims about the 8 Nov Kraków shooting spread within tens of minutes and were amplified by Russian bots and trolls; more than 2,000 accounts were reported for blocking or moderation in 24 hours, and NASK put the false claim that the gunman was a soldier at nearly 18 million reach. [50]
src: Fala dezinformacji po zamachu w Krakowie. Chaos informacyjny podsycali m.in. politycy

incidents.place: France: about 700 food-retail sites nationwide (marker at Paris)
incidents.summary: In the night of 11–12 Oct attackers took over Danfoss, Dixell and Copeland refrigeration controllers at about 700 French retail sites, forcing endless defrost cycles with alarms disabled; food losses and between 15 and about 20 fires followed. On 9 Nov France attributed the attack to the IRGC's Shahid Kaveh unit, summoned Iran's ambassador and opened a judicial case against the unit's head and two deputies. [13, 12, 52]
src: France blames Iran for fridge cyberattacks, says some caused fires
La France accuse l'Iran de la cyberattaque contre des frigos de supermarchés, une unité des Gardiens de la Révolution visée par une enquête
Frankreich macht Iran für Cyberangriffe auf Supermarkt-Kühltruhen verantwortlich

attrLog.t: Latvia's military assesses the 1 Nov drone as a Russian Geran-type that flew back into Russia. [44]
src: Latvia believes one of two drones that violated its airspace was Russian, the other Ukrainian

attrLog.t: Helsinki District Court convicted the Fitburg's captain and boatswain at first instance; an appeal is intended. [33]
src: Finnish court jails Russian captain over Baltic Sea cable sabotage

attrLog.t: Paris prosecutors opened an investigation on 7 Nov into the hoax emails and “any potential links they may have to foreign powers”; European intelligence services point to pro-Kremlin activists or hacking groups, the FT reports. [13, 69]
src: France probes if bomb threats against airlines linked to 'foreign powers'
Russia likely behind bomb hoaxes that grounded flights, say European intelligence

attrLog.t: Paris prosecutors opened an investigation on 7 Nov into the hoax emails and “any potential links they may have to foreign powers”. [13]
src: France probes if bomb threats against airlines linked to 'foreign powers'

attrLog.t: France's Cyber Crisis Coordination Centre and Foreign Minister Barrot attributed the October fridge sabotage to the IRGC's Shahid Kaveh unit; the Paris prosecutor opened a judicial investigation and requested international arrest warrants. [13, 12]
src: France blames Iran for fridge cyberattacks, says some caused fires
La France accuse l'Iran de la cyberattaque contre des frigos de supermarchés, une unité des Gardiens de la Révolution visée par une enquête
